    'Year': [2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023],

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Base CPI for 2023
cpi_2023 = 304.702

# Calculate Real Values
df['US_Real'] = df['US_Nominal'] * (cpi_2023 / df['CPI'])
df['IN_Real'] = df['IN_Nominal'] * (cpi_2023 / df['CPI'])

# Calculate Percentage Change (2015 to 2023)
real_us_2015 = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2015, 'US_Real'].values[0]
real_us_2023 = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2023, 'US_Real'].values[0]
us_pct_change = ((real_us_2023 - real_us_2015) / real_us_2015) * 100

real_in_2015 = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2015, 'IN_Real'].values[0]
real_in_2023 = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2023, 'IN_Real'].values[0]
in_pct_change = np.nan
if not np.isnan(real_in_2015) and not np.isnan(real_in_2023):
    in_pct_change = ((real_in_2023 - real_in_2015) / real_in_2015) * 100

# Save CSV
csv_cols = ['Year', 'US_Nominal', 'US_Real', 'IN_Nominal', 'IN_Real']
df[csv_cols].to_csv('income_comparison.csv', index=False)

bar_width = 0.35
index = np.arange(len(df['Year']))

plt.bar(index + bar_width, df['IN_Real'], bar_width, label='Indiana Real', color='orange')

plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.ylabel('Real Median Household Income (2023 $)')
plt.title('Real Median Household Income: US vs Indiana (2015-2023)')
plt.xticks(index + bar_width / 2, df['Year'])
plt.legend()
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('income_chart.png')

print(f"US Percentage Change: {us_pct_change:.2f}%")
print(f"IN Percentage Change: {in_pct_change}")
